dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh goodie, you're here!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Do you need help with anything? Have you been doing well lately? Come on, tell me all about it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hehe, oh, this is much livelier than my place, but it also isn't quite the bustling hive of activity the wharf is.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Of course. Oh c'mon, you don't have to worry about me.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: You see, Master has taught me that "when in an abode, do as the adepti do"... Um, wait, I think it's "the guest should go along with their host"...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: But whatever the case, I love it here!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I just hope I'm not imposing...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I—If you don't mind, I'd like to stay here a little longer.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And... you know, accompany you for a while.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: No, no, that's not what I mean.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: This place is just like an adeptus's abode — I feel welcomed and comfortable here.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: It's an honor to be invited over to play.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Sure. I love chatting!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: It's always fun, no matter who I'm talking to!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No matter who, you say? Such as?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Well, such as... cranes!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I encountered a very beautiful crane once while washing radishes by a brook.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: It had many colorful feathers, it was so pretty to look at.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I called out to it, and to my surprise, the crane could speak!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Hehe, well, let me give you some hints...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: We really hit it off, and then we shared the shredded radish salad that I made... She also told me a lot of interesting stories.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Eventually, she declared that we had been fated to meet, and gave me Yuegui.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: She made it using her very own mechanical arts, you know!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, so was that Cloud Retainer?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Bingo! Congratulations, you guessed it!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Adeptus arts, mechanics... I'm really amazed by her many powerful and practical skills.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Let's go talk to her together sometime, shall we?

choices.text: Was that Cloud Retainer, by any chance?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Whoa, you got that without any hints! How did you guess?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I guess the term "smart cookie" was made just for you, huh? Nice one.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Aunty Cloud Retainer and I had a great time chatting, and then we ate the shredded radish salad that I made... She also told me a lot of interesting stories.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Eventually, she declared that we had been fated to meet, and gave me Yuegui.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: She made it using her very own mechanical arts, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Hmm... Are you interested in finches? I think they sing very beautifully.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: And I can sing too, by the way, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, really?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Yeah! In the past, while my parents busied themselves planting herbs, I would often run off into the hills and forests to play...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: And there was one time I encountered a large finch teaching a smaller finch how to sing.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: The big finch would sing a line, the small finch would follow along, and so would I. ♪ *whistle*~ ♪

choices.text: You should come over to play more often in future!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Sure, can't say no to that!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And to thank you for "taking me under your wing," allow me to teach you the song of the finches.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Don't worry, it's waaaay easier than learning to use a spear!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Actually, I use a sword...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Oh, don't worry, Master taught me this thing called... ah, "understanding by analogy"!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I want you to see this as just us having some fun, not studying a difficult class or anything.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: So let's do it like this: I'll sing a line, and you'll follow after me.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Don't sweat the other stuff. I'll make the arrangements!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Isn't it? This is what they call, um, "finding joy in the little things"!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: And I wanna share this little bit of joy with you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Yaoyao.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Good morning. Let's have breakfast together.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: The weather is great today — I'll hang your covers to air out later...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Yaoyao.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Remember to cover up at night, or you might catch a cold.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Ooh! I can definitely whip up tons of great meals with all these kitchen implements!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Oh, don't you worry, I've learned a thing or two from Xiangling. Even Master really enjoys my food!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to eat? Just tell me and I'll make it for you right away.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Wow, this place is so neat and tidy, it's basically perfect. There's nothing for me to do here at all...

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: In which case, let's play instead!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I'll get Yuegui to hide somewhere, and you try to find it. Hehe, I play this game with my friends a lot!
